extraction.title: UX: show complete URL path if website domain is same as instance domain
extraction.head: url-handling-post

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as moving website name logic into UserSerializer#website_name, which shows either the hostname or the full path depending on how the website domain relates to the instance domain. Flags unsafe string operations and subdomain edge cases in the domain comparison in app/serializers/user_serializer.rb, and test coverage gaps. Confidence score of 2/5.

Says the `<<` string concatenation in the discourse_host.ends_with? check mutates the original string and could alter Discourse.current_hostname. Suggests using `+` instead. Suggested change: replace `<<` with `+` in the ends_with? check.
Notes that URI(website.to_s) is parsed twice in website_name, and suggests storing the parsed URI in a variable for efficiency.
